Synthetic old Grid data only. Every identity, path, host and task is a placeholder.
The test replaces /example/old-grid with its temporary source directory.
Two named homes have colliding widget project names; notes has no Git repo.
The fixture covers task frontmatter, histories, Feed JSONL, project records,
session pointers and records, usage, recall markers, knowledge and working files.
Working files have no .git link. Linked worktrees are tested separately as blocked
because moving them also needs changes in their original repository metadata.
